$comment: Bundle size budgets, checked by `yarn size` (scripts/check-size.mjs) on what `yarn build` writes to dist/.
Sizes are gzip at level 9, in kB of 1000 bytes; a group of files is the sum of each file's size, as each one is sent apart.
«measured» is the size when the budget was set; the budget is that plus about 5 %, rounded up (to 0.1 kB under 100 kB, to 1 kB above).
Raising a budget needs a reason in the commit message: see docs/testing.md.

editorHtml.what: The editor's index.html: its share tags and structured data, the inline critical CSS, the scripts that pick the theme and the language before the first paint with each language's loading texts (and what shows if the editor can't open), and the skeleton of the editor it shows until the app mounts (about 1.5 kB). The first thing a visit downloads, before the stylesheet and the scripts.

initialJs.what: The JavaScript the editor's index.html loads at start: its module script and every module it preloads. What a first visit waits for, with the texts of one language (see «languages»); React is about 68 kB of it.

*.what: Each language's texts (src/copy/<language>.ts), a chunk of its own: index.html preloads only the one it shows, so what a first visit waits for is «initialJs» plus one of these. Set on the largest, French.

hi.what: Hindi's texts: Devanagari takes three bytes a letter in UTF-8, so the same texts weigh more than in the other languages. Its font (about 121 kB of woff2, the Devanagari subset of Noto Sans Devanagari) isn't JavaScript and loads only with them.

totalJs.what: Every .js and .mjs file of the build: the editor's lazy chunks (dialogs, crop mode, each language's texts, of which only one loads), pdf.js and its worker (about 500 kB), pdf-lib twice (about 180 kB each: the export worker's, which builds the PDF, and the page's, which loads only when the worker can't), the contour and export workers and the static pages' scripts. Catches a dependency that grows or gets in by accident.

initialCss.what: The CSS the editor's index.html links (read from the built HTML), which blocks its first paint: the tokens, the base, the shared buttons and form controls, the layout, printing and the system's preferences, and the stylesheets of every component that shows at start. The parts that load later bring their own (see «totalCss»).

totalCss.what: Every .css file of the build: the editor's stylesheet, the lazy parts' (the dialogs but «confirm», the menus, crop mode, the command palette: each compressed on its own, about 0.3 to 1.1 kB, loaded when the app is idle or the part opens) and Hindi's font rule (devanagari-*.css, about 0.25 kB, loaded only with Hindi). The static pages carry their CSS inline (counted in each page).

pageScripts.what: The scripts the static pages load, built apart from the editor: today only the calculator, one file for the calculator page of every language. Grows a lot if it ever pulls in editor code.

*.what: Each static page (every .html of the build but the editor's index.html), its HTML with its inline CSS, in every language; it applies to new pages too. Set on the largest one, the calculator (es/cuantas-fotos-caben-en-una-hoja; 7.2 kB in English); the other guides are 5.5 to 6.1 kB and the legal pages 6.1 to 7.7 kB (the terms are the largest: they say what commercial use is allowed). Each carries its hreflang links and the links to its other languages (about 0.3 kB).

es/privacidad.html.what: The privacy policy, from docs/legal/privacidad.md: it lists every key the app stores in the browser, so it grows with each new setting.

en/privacy.html.what: The privacy policy in English, from docs/legal/en/privacy.md: like the Spanish one, it grows with each new setting.

es/licencias-de-terceros.html.what: The third-party licenses page, from THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: it grows with each dependency the build ships.

en/third-party-licenses.html.what: The third-party licenses page in English, the same THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: it grows with each dependency the build ships.

zh-hans/photos-per-sheet-calculator.html.what: The calculator in Simplified Chinese: Chinese takes three bytes a character in UTF-8, and the page carries the calculator's texts twice (in its HTML and as the script's JSON), so it weighs a little more than the Spanish one.

zh-hans/privacy.html.what: The privacy policy in Simplified Chinese, from docs/legal/zh-Hans/privacy.md: like the Spanish one, it grows with each new setting, and Chinese takes three bytes a character in UTF-8.

zh-hans/third-party-licenses.html.what: The third-party licenses page in Simplified Chinese, the same THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md with a Chinese introduction: it grows with each dependency the build ships.

fr/confidentialite.html.what: The privacy policy in French, from docs/legal/fr/privacy.md: like the Spanish one, it grows with each new setting, and French takes more words to say the same.

fr/licences-tierces.html.what: The third-party licenses page in French, the same THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md with a French introduction: it grows with each dependency the build ships.

hi/how-many-photos-in-a4-sheet.html.what: The calculator page in Hindi: Devanagari takes three bytes a letter in UTF-8, so the same page and calculator texts weigh about 0.7 kB more than in Spanish.

hi/terms.html.what: The terms of use in Hindi, from docs/legal/hi/terms.md: Devanagari takes three bytes a letter in UTF-8, so they weigh about 1.2 kB more than the Spanish ones.

hi/privacy.html.what: The privacy policy in Hindi, from docs/legal/hi/privacy.md: like the Spanish one, it grows with each new setting, and Devanagari takes three bytes a letter in UTF-8.

hi/third-party-licenses.html.what: The third-party licenses page in Hindi, the same THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md with a Hindi introduction and frame: it grows with each dependency the build ships.
